title: Outages and Turnarounds
summary: Does refining maintenance impact crude flows? According to the latest IEA Oil Market Report, global refinery crude throughput reached 82.2 million barrels per day (mb/d) in December 2017, some 500,000 b/d more than in December 2016. For 2017 as a whole, throughput averaged 80.8 mb/d, a solid 1.5 mb/d higher than the year before.
